description: AlgoVault returns a single composite verdict — BUY, SELL, or HOLD — for crypto perpetual futures, with confidence, market regime, funding rate, and plain-language reasoning, instead of raw indicators you'd still have to interpret. Every call is scored against outcomes and the win rate is published with a Merkle anchor on Base, so you can verify the track record on-chain rather than trust a screenshot. Coverage spans major perpetual-futures venues (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Hyperliquid and more) across 11 timeframes, plus a cross-venue funding-rate scanner and search over AlgoVault's research. AlgoVault is read-only decision-support: it analyzes; you decide. It never places orders, moves funds, or touches your accounts.
